title: Imperial Cities Circuit
subtitle: The Four Royal Cities: Casablanca, Rabat, Fès & Marrakech
description: Dive into Morocco's thousand-year history through its four imperial cities. An exceptional journey through Andalusian-Islamic architecture, labyrinthine medinas, royal palaces and authentic culinary traditions.

itinerary.title: Casablanca – Arrival & Hassan II
itinerary.details: Visit the Grand Mosque Hassan II, Corniche, El Hank

itinerary.title: Rabat – Royal Capital
itinerary.details: Mohammed V Mausoleum, Hassan Tower, Kasbah of the Udayas

itinerary.title: Fès – Millennial Medina
itinerary.details: Al-Qarawiyyin, Chouara Tanneries, Borj Nord Museum

itinerary.title: Fès – Merinids & Bab Boujloud
itinerary.details: Merinid Tombs, Bou Inania Madrasa, souks

itinerary.title: Road to Marrakech
itinerary.details: Ifrane palm grove, Azrou cedars, Zad pass

itinerary.title: Marrakech – The Pink City
itinerary.details: Jemaa el-Fna, Bahia Palace, Saadian Tombs, souks & medina

title: Sahara Desert Circuit
subtitle: Marrakech → Dadès Gorges → Merzouga → Marrakech
description: Morocco's most iconic circuit: cross the breathtaking Atlas landscapes, the kasbahs of the Road of a Thousand Kasbahs, Dadès and Todra gorges, and end under the stars in a Berber camp in the heart of the Merzouga dunes.

itinerary.title: Marrakech → Aït Benhaddou → Ouarzazate
itinerary.details: Tichka Pass (2260m), Aït Benhaddou Ksar (UNESCO), film studios

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate → Dadès Gorges → Merzouga
itinerary.details: Drâa Valley, M'Gouna roses, Todra Gorges, Erg Chebbi dunes

itinerary.title: Sunrise → Return to Marrakech
itinerary.details: Dawn camel ride, Road of Kasbahs, evening return

title: Southern Morocco Circuit
subtitle: Marrakech → Ouarzazate → Drâa → Zagora → Marrakech
description: Discover Morocco's deep south through palm-lined oases, spectacular gorges, ancient kasbahs and golden sand dunes. A comprehensive circuit to explore the hidden treasures of rural Morocco.

itinerary.title: Marrakech → Aït Benhaddou
itinerary.details: Tichka Pass, UNESCO Aït Benhaddou Ksar, overnight in Ouarzazate

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate → Skoura → Drâa Valley
itinerary.details: Skoura palm grove, Amridil Kasbah, Drâa oasis

itinerary.title: Zagora & M'Hamid Dunes
itinerary.details: Zagora desert, M'Hamid dunes, overnight in Berber bivouac

itinerary.title: Return via Dadès Gorges
itinerary.details: Dadès Gorges, Valley of Roses, Todra Gorges
